P26 = dict(c=["-1.702","-0.51","-0.195797762","0.155193392","0.755672784","1"],
  g0=["0.214789562","0.249182503","0.237832565","0.245204742","0.353848357"],
  g1=["0.566334104","0.496228487","0.518584061","0.498857638","0.502412430"])
def gam_ppsw2(c, g0, g1, sg):   # APNUM (3.8) for i<s, (3.6) for i=s ; works for numpy and mpmath
    s=len(c); g=[g0[i]/(1+sg*g1[i]) for i in range(s-1)]
    g.append(1/(sg*sum(1/(1+sg-cj) for cj in c))); return g
def coeffs_np(c, g, sg):
    c=np.asarray(c,float); g=np.asarray(g,float); s=len(c); tau=(c-1)/sg
    Wt=np.vander(tau,s,increasing=True).T            # Wt[k,j]=tau_j^k
    Cp=np.array([c**k for k in range(s)])            # Cp[k,i]=c_i^k
    ThT=np.linalg.solve(Wt,Cp); Th=ThT.T
    A=g[:,None]*Th
    Dm=np.zeros((s,s))
    for k in range(1,s): Dm[k]=k*tau**(k-1)
    R2=Cp-Dm@A.T
    B=np.linalg.solve(Wt,R2).T
    return B,A,-A,Th
def coeffs_mp(c, g, sg):
    mp.mp.dps=mp.mp.dps; s=len(c); tau=[(cj-1)/sg for cj in c]
    Wt=mp.matrix(s,s); Cp=mp.matrix(s,s); Dm=mp.zeros(s,s)
    for k in range(s):
        for j in range(s):
            Wt[k,j]=tau[j]**k; Cp[k,j]=c[j]**k
            if k>=1: Dm[k,j]=k*tau[j]**(k-1)
    Wi=Wt**-1
    Th=(Wi*Cp).T
    A=mp.matrix(s,s)
    for i in range(s):
        for j in range(s): A[i,j]=g[i]*Th[i,j]
    B=(Wi*(Cp-Dm*A.T)).T
    return B,A

RIC=dict(n=1,T=M_(2),ex=lambda t: mp.matrix([1/(1+t)]),f=lambda t,y: mp.matrix([-y[0]**2]),J=lambda t,y: mp.matrix([[-2*y[0]]]))

def table(meth,prob,Ns,mode,Tpert,**kw):
    rows=[]
    for N in Ns:
        e_all,e_end,smax,_=run(meth,prob,N,mode,Tpert,**kw); rows.append((N,e_all,e_end,smax))
    out=[]
    for k,(N,ea,ee,sm) in enumerate(rows):
        po=None if k==0 else (np.log(rows[k-1][1]/ea)/np.log(N/rows[k-1][0]) if ea>0 and rows[k-1][1]>0 else None)
        out.append(dict(N=N,err_maxstages_last_step=ea,err_endpoint_stage_s=ee,sigma_max_used=sm,order_vs_prev=None if po is None else round(po,3)))

    c,gam=METHODS["PPSW2-6"]; s=6; prob=RIC; out=[]

        g,B,A=step_coeffs(c,gam,sg)

        tp=[t0+c[j]*hp for j in range(s)]; Yp=[prob["ex"](x) for x in tp]; F=[prob["f"](tp[j],Yp[j]) for j in range(s)]
        Tm=prob["J"](tp[s-1],Yp[s-1])
        tn=[t0+hp+c[i]*h for i in range(s)]; Yn=[]
        for i in range(s):

            Yn.append(mp.lu_solve(mp.eye(1)-h*g[i]*Tm,rhs))
